name: cs-raci-matrix
description: Builds a Support RACI Matrix showing who owns what across support, success, sales, product and engineering, flags gaps and double owners, and sets a rule for new asks. Use for "run cs-raci-matrix", "support is the dumping ground", "who owns this task", "RACI for customer service", "responsibility matrix for support", "scope between support and success", "stop support picking up everything", part of the AI for Customer Service Pack by 90n.
